properties.description: Drives review_relations and add_decision through the service's own handlers on an in-memory design. Pins both halves: a link that says alignment "supporting" is stored supporting and is not reported as a contradiction, and a link that says nothing still stores the schema default `opposing` and is still reported, so no caller that sends today's arguments sees a different result. Also pins the refusals: a value the schema does not allow, a property the link's relation does not declare, and a value that differs from an edge already stored, each refused naming what would have been legal and with nothing written.
properties.findings: 2026-10-13 on branch fix/review-relations-can-say-a-contradiction-supports at 12c543617: 6 passed, 0 failed. Before the fix, on main c58305ba8 with only the test added (commit 5090b58c6): 5 of 6 FAILED, each with "unknown field `alignment`, expected one of `relation`, `other_type`, `other_id`, `evidence`, `incoming`, `other_design`, `other_name`"; the omitted-alignment case passed, as it must.
properties.name: A contradiction drawn as corroboration through review_relations is stored supporting
